gloss: trial calculation; preliminary estimate; tentative computation

definitions.gloss: trial calculation; preliminary estimate; tentative computation
definitions.explanation: a preliminary calculation made to check or estimate figures before making a final determination; often used in business and financial planning

examples.japanese: {費用|ひよう}を{試算|しさん}してみた。
examples.english: I did a preliminary cost calculation.

examples.japanese: {試算|しさん}では{年間|ねんかん}{一億円|いちおくえん}の{削減|さくげん}になる。
examples.english: According to preliminary calculations, it would result in annual savings of 100 million yen.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{経済効果|けいざいこうか}を{試算|しさん}した。
examples.english: The government calculated a preliminary estimate of the economic impact.

notes:
FORMATION:
{試|し} (trial, test) + {算|さん} (calculation) → trial calculation

CAN FUNCTION AS:
- Noun: {試算|しさん}を{行|おこな}う (to conduct a trial calculation)
- Suru-verb: {試算|しさん}する (to make a trial calculation)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {試算|しさん}{表|ひょう} (trial balance - accounting term)
- {試算|しさん}{結果|けっか} (results of trial calculation)
- ～と{試算|しさん}される (to be estimated at ~)

CONTEXT:
Commonly used in:
- Government policy announcements
- Business planning and budgeting
- Financial analysis
- Project feasibility studies

RELATED:
- {概算|がいさん} (rough estimate)
- {見積|みつも}り (estimate, quotation)
- {計算|けいさん} (calculation - general)
- {精算|せいさん} (exact calculation, settlement)
